Programs

Workout plans that tell you exactly what to do

All plans
Beginner · General fitness Beginner Full Body Workout A 3-day full body gym plan for beginners. Learn the big lifts, add weight every week and build a solid base of strength and muscle in 12 weeks. 3 days/week45-60 min
Intermediate · Muscle gain Push Pull Legs Split A 6-day push pull legs routine for building muscle. Full schedule with sets, reps and rest times, plus how to progress, deload and adjust it. 6 days/week60-75 min
Intermediate · Strength and muscle Upper Lower Split A 4-day upper lower split that trains every muscle twice a week. Strength and hypertrophy days, full sets and reps, and a clear way to progress. 4 days/week60-70 min

Start here

Every goal starts with one number: your maintenance calories.

Lose fat, build muscle or recomp, you need to know what you burn in a normal day first. The TDEE calculator gives you that in under a minute, then the macro calculator turns it into grams of protein, carbs and fat.

Guides

Straight answers, backed by research

All guides
Fat Loss How to calculate your calories for weight loss, step by step Work out your maintenance calories, pick a sensible deficit and adjust it from real scale data. A step-by-step method with worked examples and tables.
Nutrition How much protein do you really need to build muscle? The evidence-based protein target for muscle growth, how to split it across meals, the best food sources, and when eating more actually helps.
Health & Recovery BMI vs body fat percentage: what each number really tells you BMI is quick, body fat percentage is more telling. Learn what each measures, where BMI misleads lifters, and how to track body composition properly.
Training The beginner's gym guide: your first month, step by step Nervous about starting at the gym? A practical plan for your first four weeks: what to do, how much to lift, gym etiquette, and how to keep progressing.
Training Progressive overload explained: the principle behind every gain Progressive overload is how you get stronger and build muscle. Learn six ways to apply it, a simple double progression system, and how to beat a stall.
Fat Loss How to lose belly fat: an honest plan that works You can't spot-reduce belly fat, but you can lose it. An honest, evidence-based plan covering calories, training, sleep, alcohol and how to measure progress.

Who's behind FormFit

Built by someone who trains, not a supplement brand.

Hi, I'm Khushi Gupta. I run FormFit and edit everything on it. The idea is simple: every number you get here comes with the formula behind it, an honest note on how far to trust it, and a clear next step. Nothing to buy, no sign-up.

More about FormFit and how it's made

Private by design

Calculators run in your browser. Your weight, measurements and lifts are never sent to a server.

Shows its working

Every result names the formula and the study it came from, with honest notes on where it falls short.

Fast on any phone

No app, no account, no waiting. Pages load fast and work on the gym floor with one bar of signal.
